segments.text: One of the most powerful questions you can ask yourself is is your action bringing you towards your values or is your action
Taking you away from your values
Every day we are faced with countless opportunities to move toward or away
Should I speak up or be quiet in a difficult conversation?
Should I reach out for a hug at the end of the day when I see my partner or just get on with my phone
Asking ourselves this question will my action bring me toward my values or away from my values
Is one of the most effective ways to ground yourself in intentional living
